document.status_note: Short, product-independent set of the essential checks the Studio gates on. Product-specific values (required and forbidden modules) come from the product profile in app/products.py. The detailed PCR rulesets in data/pcr_rulesets are kept for reference but are not evaluated.

rules.title: Functional or declared unit stated
rules.requirement: Results must refer to a functional unit or a declared unit.

rules.title: Product mass known
rules.requirement: The mass of one declared product (or of the BOM) must be greater than zero.

rules.title: Reference service life stated
rules.requirement: A reference service life is needed when use-stage modules are declared.

rules.title: End-of-life shares add up to 100 %
rules.requirement: Recycling, incineration and landfill shares of the end-of-life scenario should add up to 100 %.

rules.title: Product stage (A1-A3) declared
rules.requirement: Every EPD declares the product stage (A1-A3).

rules.title: Core impact indicators calculated
rules.requirement: Every mandatory core impact indicator of the selected LCIA method has a result.

rules.title: Modules required for this product declared
rules.requirement: The life-cycle modules the product's PCR requires should have results.

rules.title: Modules not allowed for this product left out
rules.requirement: Modules the product's PCR does not allow (e.g. D for chillers) must not be declared.

rules.title: Comparability statement present
rules.requirement: The EPD states that EPDs from different programmes or PCRs may not be comparable.

rules.title: No unsupported environmental claims
rules.requirement: Claims such as 'free of' or 'harmless' are not allowed in an EPD.
